question: Should OpenClaw sponsor multi-role memory slots in core now, or keep the current single active memory slot and narrow the work to specific hook/protocol gaps?
rationale: The source confirms the limitation, but resolving it adds public config and plugin API surface that conflicts with the current VISION memory direction unless maintainers intentionally update that direction.

options.title: Review the role-slot PR as the candidate path
options.body: Use `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504` as the canonical implementation candidate, with owner review focused on config compatibility, doctor migration, runtime ownership, and SDK docs before merge.

options.title: Keep one active memory slot
options.body: Reject the multi-slot architecture for now, document the single-slot direction, and close or redirect related memory-composition requests to narrower plugin/API gaps.

options.title: Narrow to specific memory protocols first
options.body: Keep this issue open as design context but ask for smaller PRs for dreaming, user-modeling, or capture hooks before adding a full role-slot taxonomy.

recommendation.title: Review the role-slot PR as the candidate path
recommendation.body: Use `https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504` as the canonical implementation candidate, with owner review focused on config compatibility, doctor migration, runtime ownership, and SDK docs before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main blame and release ownership point to this contributor for the active slot/runtime surface, making them the best available routing owner for the API compatibility decision.
